The '''Prak City Guards''' were the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] basic guard unit in [[Prak City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. Prak City Guards maintained order in the [[Work Zone sector]] during construction and therefore were most often seen during the day, when a show of force in front of workers had the most visual impact. Lead by a [[Prak City Guard Commander]] who once served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the guards grew more willingly aggressive as time went on but only acted with lethal force if it was used against them first. They always coordinated their attacks to flank opponents on both sides. They occasionally worked with the Imperial [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], and once sent a squad to support the Inquisitor [[Jorad]].<ref name="Sword" />
